supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic connections are attributable to casebinderupd.exe (PID 5632) on WS-NKIM-01 and repeatedly target update.casebinder.co through the explicit proxy. Observed requests occur at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:40 through 14:09 UTC.

The contacted hostname is update.casebinder.co, whereas the inventory identifies the approved CaseBinder updater check-in host as update.casebinder.com. The observed hostname differs by its top-level domain.
The updater ran from Noah Kim's AppData\Local folder, not the inventory-listed C:\Program Files\CaseBinder location, and its recorded parent process was Firefox launched with a redditstatic.com URL.

The combination of the lookalike update hostname, unexpected executable location, and browser parent process makes the alerted activity strongly suspicious and supports a malicious finding. The records do not establish what the updater transferred or whether its binary was signed or harmful.

known_telemetry_limitations: The updater's successful proxy records show CONNECT tunnels; the available evidence does not expose the TLS contents, update payload, or any data exchanged inside those tunnels.
The provided records do not include the updater's hash, signature-validation result, file origin/download history, or a security verdict for the contacted domain.
The proxy and network records establish connections via PROXY-MAP-01, not a direct workstation-to-internet connection.
claims_not_established: Whether the binary is a malicious impostor, a legitimate but incorrectly configured updater, or otherwise unauthorized software.
Whether any payload was downloaded, executed, or sent during the connections.
Whether the user knowingly initiated or approved the updater.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and analyze the updater binary, including its hash, digital signature, file metadata, and any available EDR verdict.
Collect browser download history and file-creation provenance for the AppData\Local\CaseBinder executable.
Obtain proxy TLS inspection or other available transaction details for the update.casebinder.co sessions, plus DNS, certificate, and domain-registration information.
Review endpoint process and file telemetry for child processes, downloaded files, persistence, and other activity associated with PID 5632 and the executable.
unrelated_findings: DropboxUpdate contacted desktop.dropbox.com from WS-NKIM-01. Dropbox is not among the approved services in the provided inventory; review separately. (T155-00253, T155-00254)

A network authentication for ali.hassan originated from WS-NKIM-01 and was accepted on WS-AHASSAN-01. This is separate from the alerted updater activity and should be reviewed against the stated remote-administration practice. (T155-00102, T155-00104, T155-00105)

WS-NKIM-01 received network logons for noah.kim associated with source addresses 10.53.10.23 and 10.53.20.20; the latter record identifies FILE-MAP-01 as the workstation name. The source represented by 10.53.10.23 is not identified in the provided inventory. Review separately. (T155-00198, T155-00200, T155-00204, T155-00205, T155-00207)
